description.text: A special Scarlet & Violet set released on 18 July 2025 beside Black Bolt, the two together holding all 156 Pokémon first found in Unova. White Flare has Tepig's and Oshawott's lines up to Emboar and Samurott and the Legendary and Mythical Reshiram ex and Keldeo ex, 70 illustration rares, one for each Pokémon, and parallel cards with Poké Ball patterns. Its 86 cards go up to 173 with secret rares, ending with a Reshiram ex in the new Black White Rare, beside a Victini found in both sets.
